title: Geometry of pseudo-non-degenerate two-ruled hypersurfaces
summary: We investigate the singularities of two-ruled hypersurfaces in the Euclidean four-space. By considering the points that minimize the distance between adjacent rulings, we obtain a characterization the striction curve. We introduce the notion of pseudo-non-degenerate two-ruled hypersurfaces and examine their fundamental properties. We show that two-ruled hypersurfaces constructed from a curve equipped with a Frenet-type frame, via height functions, are pseudo-non-degenerate.
